content.text: You’ve spent months perfecting your digital art. Your Instagram following is growing. Buyers are messaging you directly, ready to purchase. But when they ask how to pay, you freeze. Stripe and PayPal are [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/blocked-earning-real-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-my-unfiltered-take-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-tanzanian-online-sellers-2|blocked]] in Nigeria. Local payment gateways charge 5% fees and fail 30% of transactions. You’ve tried workarounds—friends in the US, crypto wallets, barter systems—but nothing sticks. This isn’t a temporary problem. It’s a structural one. Stripe and PayPal exclude entire countries based on risk models built for Western markets. Their algorithms flag your IP address, your currency, your location. You’re not their customer. But you don’t need them. Sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|The Full]] gives you ownership of the entire stack. No platforms. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. Your store runs on GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and crypto payments verified on-chain. This is how you sell digital art without begging for access.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital paypal

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership, not rental. It’s a complete digital commerce stack you control from top to bottom. Hosting, backend logic, order storage, file delivery, payment processing—all built on tools you own. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store for free. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend tasks without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 delivers your files instantly. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain with a 0.5% fee. No platform can shut you down. No subscription can expire. No algorithm decides if you’re allowed to sell. This isn’t a workaround for Stripe’s absence. It’s a permanent alternative built on open infrastructure. You deploy it once, and it’s yours. No one can revoke access. No one can change the rules. Your store operates in Lagos, Nairobi, Karachi, or Caracas the same way it would in London or Los Angeles. This is commerce sovereignty.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular but integrated. Start with hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve your storefront. Both are free, global, and CDN-backed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers (for Edge Commerce Stack) or Google Apps Script (for Sovereign Starter Stack). Workers are serverless functions that execute at the edge, closer to your buyers. Apps Script is simpler but still powerful for basic tasks. Orders are stored in Supabase (a Postgres database) or Google Sheets. Supabase scales better, while Sheets is easier to set up. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Both are reliable, but R2 is faster for global buyers. Payments are processed via NOWPayments. Buyers send crypto to your wallet. NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and fires a webhook to your backend. The webhook triggers file delivery. The entire process is automatic, secure, and platform-independent. You own the code, the data, and the workflow.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, and Paddle are unavailable or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, or software, this is for you. If your buyers are in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, or the Philippines, this is for you. If you’ve been rejected by payment processors, flagged by algorithms, or locked out of platforms, this is for you. You don’t need to beg for access. You don’t need to rely on friends in the US or Europe. You don’t need to pay 5% fees to local gateways that fail 30% of transactions. You need infrastructure sovereignty. You need to own the stack. This is how you build a business that can’t be blocked, revoked, or restricted. This is how you sell globally from anywhere.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you ownership, not rental. Your store can’t be shut down.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component is chosen for reliability, cost, and sovereignty. GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are free, global, and CDN-backed. Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script are serverless, meaning you don’t manage servers. Supabase and Google Sheets store your data securely. Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. The stack is integrated via webhooks and APIs. When a payment confirms on-chain, NOWPayments sends a webhook to your backend. The backend verifies the payment, logs the order, and triggers file delivery. The buyer gets their product instantly. You get paid directly to your wallet. No middlemen. No platform fees. No gatekeepers. The components work together seamlessly, giving you a fully operational store in 48 hours. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration and end-to-end testing to ensure everything works perfectly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is ideal for beginners. It uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is for professionals. It uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Both stacks are deployed in 48 hours. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to order. After deployment, you own everything. No subscriptions. No platform access required. Load your products, set your prices, and start selling. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low-fee transactions (under $0.10 per payment). Share your store link with your audience. When a buyer pays, the system verifies the payment and delivers the file automatically. You focus on creating. The infrastructure handles the rest. This is how you build a business that can’t be stopped. This is commerce sovereignty.

Unlike platforms like Stripe or PayPal, it’s not rented—it’s yours. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely. No subscriptions. No gatekeepers. No platform fees. It’s built on open tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This gives you the freedom to sell digital products globally, even in regions where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It’s commerce sovereignty.
Crypto payments via NOWPayments mean no buyer accounts, no KYC, and 0.5% fees only.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to order. 2. Provide your product files and store details. COREMERCH will deploy your stack in 48 hours. 3. After deployment, log in to your GitHub or Cloudflare account to access your store. 4. Load your products, set your prices, and configure your payment wallet in NOWPayments. 5. Share your store link with your audience. Test the entire workflow to ensure payments and file delivery work seamlessly. 6. Use BSC, Solana, or TRON for low-fee transactions. Monitor your sales and payouts directly in your crypto wallet.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The stacks are pre-built and deployed for you. You don’t need to write code. After deployment, you manage your store through simple interfaces like Google Sheets or Supabase dashboards. The Edge Commerce Stack includes 30-day support to help you get started.
What cryptocurrencies can my buyers use?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON (under $0.10 per transaction). You can also accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT or USDC.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?

No. The stacks are one-time purchases. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages is free. Backend logic, order storage, and file delivery use free tiers of Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Sheets, or Google Drive. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee only when you make a sale.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform you depend on. If it fails, you can switch to another crypto payment gateway without changing your stack. The architecture is modular and platform-independent.
Can I scale this for thousands of sales?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is built for scalability. Cloudflare Workers and Supabase can handle high traffic. File delivery via Cloudflare R2 is fast and reliable globally. The stack is designed to grow with your business.
